verse.dictionaryTitle: The Greek Dictionary of New Testament Words

keynum.meaning: Indexes for Dictionary.
; of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first: --Alpha
; of Hebrew origin ( h0175); Aaron, the brother of Moses: - Aaron
; of Hebrew origin ( h0011); a destroying angel: - Abaddon
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g0922 (βάρος); weightless, i.e. (figuratively) not burdensome: - from being burdensome
; of Chaldee origin ( h0002); father as a vocative: - Abba
; of Hebrew origin ( h1893); Abel, the son of Adam: - Abel
; of Hebrew origin ( h0029); Abijah, the name of two Israelites: - Abia
; of Hebrew origin ( h0054); Abiathar, an Israelite: - Abiathar
; of foreign origin (compare h0058); Abilene, a region of Syria: - Abilene
; of Hebrew origin ( h0031); Abihud, an Israelite: - Abiud
; of Hebrew origin ( h0085); Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch: - Abraham
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a variation of g1037 (βυθός); depthless, i.e. (specially) (infernal) "abyss": - deep, (bottomless) pit
; of Hebrew origin (compare h2285); Agabus, an Israelite: - Agabus
; from g0018 (ἀγαθός) and g2041 (ἔργον); to work good: - do good
; from g0017 (ἀγαθοποιός); to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty): - (when) do good (well)
; from g0017 (ἀγαθοποιός); well-doing, i.e. virtue: - well-doing
; from g0018 (ἀγαθός) and g4160 (ποιέω); a well-doer, i.e. virtuous: - them that do well
; a primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun): - benefit, good(-s, things), well
; from g0018 (ἀγαθός); goodness, i.e. virtue or beneficence: - goodness
; from g0021 (ἀγαλλιάω); exultation; specially, welcome: - gladness, (exceeding) joy
; from agan (much) and g0242 (ἅλλομαι); properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult: - be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly)
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g1062 (γάμος); unmarried: - unmarried
; from (much) and (grief; akin to the base of g0043 (ἀγκάλη)); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant: - be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation
; from g0023 (ἀγανακτέω); indignation: - indignation
; perhaps from (much) (or compare h5689); to love (in a social or moral sense): - (be-)love(-ed)
; from g0025 (ἀγαπάω); love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast: - (feast of) charity(-ably), dear, love
; from g0025 (ἀγαπάω); beloved: - (dearly, well) beloved, dear
; of Hebrew origin ( h1904); Hagar, the concubine of Abraham: - Hagar
; of foreign origin (compare h0104); properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service: - compel (to go)
; from (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of g0043 (ἀγκάλη)); a receptacle: - vessel
; from g0032 (ἄγγελος); an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept: - message
; from (probably derived from g0071 (ἄγω); compare g0034 (ἀγέλη)) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor: - angel, messenger
; imperative of g0071 (ἄγω); properly, lead, i.e. come on: - go to
; from g0071 (ἄγω) (compare g0032 (ἄγγελος)); a drove: - herd
; from g0001 (Α) (as negative particle) and g1075 (γενεαλογέω); unregistered as to birth: - without descent
; from g0001 (Α) (as negative particle) and g1085 (γένος); properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble: - base things
; from g0040 (ἅγιος); to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate: - hallow, be holy, sanctify
; from g0037 (ἁγιάζω); properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier: - holiness, sanctification
; neuter of g0040 (ἅγιος); a sacred thing (i.e. spot): - holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary
; from (an awful thing) (compare g0053 (ἁγνός), g2282 (θάλπω)); sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated): - (most) holy (one, thing), saint
; from g0040 (ἅγιος); sanctity (i.e. properly, the state): - holiness
; from g0040 (ἅγιος); sacredness (i.e. properly, the quality): - holiness
; from (a bend, "ache"); an arm (as curved): - arm
; from the same as g0043 (ἀγκάλη); a hook (as bent): - hook
; from the same as g0043 (ἀγκάλη); an "anchor" (as crooked): - anchor
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the same as g1102 (γναφεύς); properly, unfulled, i.e. (by implication) new (cloth): - new
; from g0053 (ἁγνός); cleanliness (the quality), i.e. (specially) chastity: - purity
; from g0053 (ἁγνός); to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally): - purify (self)
; from g0048 (ἁγνίζω); a cleansing (the act), i.e. (ceremonially) lustration: - purification

; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g3539 (νοιέω); not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination): - (be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown
; from g0050 (ἀγνοέω); a thing ignored, i.e. shortcoming: - error
; from g0050 (ἀγνοέω); ignorance (properly, the quality): - ignorance
; from the same as g0040 (ἅγιος); properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect: - chaste, clean, pure
; from g0053 (ἁγνός); cleanness (the state), i.e. (figuratively) blamelessness: - pureness
; adverb from g0053 (ἁγνός); purely, i.e. honestly: - sincerely
; from g0001 (Α) (as negative particle) and g1108 (γνῶσις); ignorance (properly, the state): - ignorance, not the knowledge
; from g0001 (Α) (as negative particle) and g1110 (γνωστός); unknown: - unknown
; from (to gather; probably akin to g1453 (ἐγείρω)); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare: - market(-place), street
; from g0058 (ἀγορά); properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem: - buy, redeem
; from g0058 (ἀγορά); relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar: - baser sort, low
; from g0071 (ἄγω); (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish): - draught
; from g0001 (Α) (as negative particle) and g1121 (γράμμα); unlettered, i.e. illiterate: - unlearned
; from g0068 (ἀγρός) and g0832 (αὐλέω) (in the sense of g0833 (αὐλή)); to camp out: - abide in the field
; from g0061 (ἄγρα); to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap: - catch
; from g0066 (ἄγριος) and g1636 (ἐλαία); an oleaster: - olive tree (which is) wild
; from g0068 (ἀγρός); wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce): - wild, raging
; apparently from g0066 (ἄγριος) and g2462 (ἵππος); wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods: - Agrippa
; from g0071 (ἄγω); a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet: - country, farm, piece of ground, land
; ultimately from g0001 (Α) (as negative particle) and g5258 (ὕπνος); to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake: - watch
; from g0069 (ἀγρυπνέω); sleeplessness, i.e. a keeping awake: - watch

; a primary verb; properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce: - be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open
; reduplicated from g0071 (ἄγω); a bringing up, i.e. mode of living: - manner of life
; from g0071 (ἄγω); properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety: - conflict, contention, fight, race
; from g0073 (ἀγών); a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish: - agony

; from g0073 (ἀγών); to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something): - fight, labor fervently, strive
; of Hebrew origin ( h0121); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative): - Adam
; from g0001 (Α) (as negative particle); and g1160 (δαπάνη); costless, i.e. gratuitous: - without expense
; probably of Hebrew origin (compare h5716); Addi, an Israelite: - Addi
; feminine of g0080 (ἀδελφός); a sister (naturally or ecclesiastically): - sister
; from g0001 (Α) (as a connective particle) and (the womb); a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like g0001 (Α)): - brother
; from g0080 (ἀδελφός); brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity: - brethren, brotherhood
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g1212 (δῆλος); hidden, figuratively, indistinct: - appear not, uncertain
; from g0082 (ἄδηλος); uncertainty: - X uncertain
; adverb from g0082 (ἄδηλος); uncertainly: - uncertainly
; from a derivative of (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress (of mind): - be full of heaviness, be very heavy
; from g0001 (Α) (as negative particle) and g1492 (εἴδω); properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls: - grave, hell
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g1252 (διακρίνω); properly, undistinguished, i.e. (actively) impartial: - without partiality
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of g1223 (διά) and g3007 (λείπω); unintermitted, i.e. permanent: - without ceasing, continual
; adverb from g0088 (ἀδιάλειπτος); uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion): - without ceasing
; from a derivative of a compound of g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g1311 (διαφθείρω); incorruptibleness, i.e. (figuratively) purity (of doctrine): - uncorruptness
; from g0094 (ἄδικος); to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically): - hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong
; from g0091 (ἀδικέω); a wrong done: - evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong
; from g0094 (ἄδικος); (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act): - iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g1349 (δίκη); unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen: - unjust, unrighteous
; adverb from g0094 (ἄδικος); unjustly: - wrongfully
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g1384 (δόκιμος); unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally): - castaway, rejected, reprobate
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle); and g1388 (δόλος); undeceitful, i.e. (figuratively) unadulterated: - sincere
; from (a place in Asia Minor); Adramyttene or belonging to Adramyttium: - of Adramyttium
; from (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the Ionian): - Adria
; from (stout); plumpness, i.e. (figuratively) liberality: - abundance
; from g0102 (ἀδύνατος); to be unable, i.e. (passively) impossible: - be impossible
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g1415 (δυνατός); unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible: - could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak
; a primary verb; to sing: - sing
; from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration); "ever," by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly: - always, ever
; from the same as g0109 (ἀήρ); an eagle (from its wind-like flight): - eagle
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2219 (ζύμη); unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week: - unleavened (bread)
; of Hebrew origin (compare h5809); Azor, an Israelite: - Azorigin
; of Hebrew origin ( h0795); Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine: - Azotus
; from (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient): - air
; from a compound of g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2288 (θάνατος); deathlessness: - immortality
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (statute; from the base of g5087 (τίθημι)); illegal; by implication, flagitious: - abominable, unlawful thing
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2316 (θεός); godless: - without God
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g5087 (τίθημι) (in the sense of enacting); lawless, i.e. (by implication) criminal: - wicked

; from a compound of g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g5087 (τίθημι); to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate: - cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject
; from g0114 (ἀθετέω); cancellation (literally or figuratively): - disannulling, put away
; plural of (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city); Athenæ, the capitol of Greece: - Athens
; from g0116 (Ἀθῆναι); an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ: - Athenian
; from (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the competitive games: - strive
; from g0118 (ἀθλέω); a struggle (figuratively): - fight
; from a compound of g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2372 (θυμός); to be spiritless, i.e. disheartened: - be dismayed
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of g5087 (τίθημι) (meaning a penalty); not guilty: - innocent
; from (a goat); belonging to a goat: - goat
; from (to rush) and g0251 (ἅλς) (in the sense of the sea; a beach (on which the waves dash): - shore
; from g0125 (Αἴγυπτος); an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus: - Egyptian
; of uncertain derivation; Ægyptus, the land of the Nile: - Egypt
; from g0104 (ἀεί); everduring (forward and backward, or forward only): - eternal, everlasting
; perhaps from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g1492 (εἴδω) (through the idea of downcast eyes); bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe: - reverence, shamefacedness
; from (to scorch) and (the face, from g3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)); an Æthiopian (as a blackamoor): - Ethiopian
; of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred: - blood
; from g0129 (αἷμα) and a derivative of g1632 (ἐκχέω); an effusion of blood: - shedding of blood
; from g0129 (αἷμα) and g4482 (ῥέω); to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage: - diseased with an issue of blood
; of uncertain derivation; Ænĕas, an Israelite: - Æneas
; from g0134 (αἰνέω); a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a thank(-offering): - praise
; from g0136 (αἶνος); to praise (God): - praise
; from a derivative of g0136 (αἶνος) (in its primary sense); an obscure saying ("enigma"), i.e. (abstractly) obscureness: - X darkly
; apparently a prime word; properly, a story, but used in the sense of g1868 (ἔπαινος); praise (of God): - praise
; of Hebrew origin (a derivative of g5869, place of springs); Ænon, a place in Palestine: - Ænon
; probably akin to g0142 (αἴρω); to take for oneself, i.e. to prefer: - choose
; from g0138 (αἱρέομαι); properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly) disunion: - heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect
; from a derivative of g0138 (αἱρέομαι); to make a choice: - choose
; from the same as g0140 (αἱρετίζω); a schismatic: - heretic (the Greek word itself)

; a primary root; to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare h5375) to expiate sin: - away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up)
; of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly, by the senses): - perceive
; from g0143 (αἰσθάνομαι); perception, i.e. (figuratively) discernment: - judgment
; from a derivative of g0143 (αἰσθάνομαι); properly, an organ of perception, i.e. (figuratively) judgment: - senses
; from g0150 (αἰσχρός) and (gain); sordid: - given to (greedy of) filthy lucre
; adverb from g0146 (αἰσχροκερδής); sordidly: - for filthy lucre's sake
; from g0150 (αἰσχρός) and g3056 (λόγος); vile conversation: - filthy communication
; neuter of g0150 (αἰσχρός); a shameful thing, i.e. indecorum: - shame
; from the same as g0153 (αἰσχύνομαι); shameful, i.e. base (specially, venal): - filthy
; from g0150 (αἰσχρός); shamefulness, i.e. obscenity: - filthiness
; from g0153 (αἰσχύνομαι); shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely): - dishonesty, shame
; from (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for oneself): - be ashamed
; of uncertain derivation; to ask (in genitive case): - ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require
; from g0154 (αἰτέω); a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking: - petition, request, required
; from the same as g0154 (αἰτέω); a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved): - accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore)
; from a derivative of g0156 (αἰτία); a thing charged: - complaint
; neuter of g0159 (αἴτιος); a reason or crime (like g0156 (αἰτία)): - cause, fault
; from the same as g0154 (αἰτέω); causative, i.e. (concretely) a causer: - author
; from a compound of g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g5316 (φαίνω) (compare g1810 (ἐξαίφνης)) (meaning non-apparent); unexpected, i.e. (adverbially) suddenly: - sudden, unawares
; from g0164 (αἰχμάλωτος); captivity: - captivity
; from g0164 (αἰχμάλωτος); to capture (like g0163 (αἰχμαλωτίζω)): - lead captive
; from g0164 (αἰχμάλωτος); to make captive: - lead away captive, bring into captivity
; from (a spear) and a derivative of the same as g0259 (ἅλωσις); properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive: - captive

; from the same as g0104 (ἀεί); properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future): - age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end)
; from g0165 (αἰών); perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well): - eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began)
; from g0169 (ἀκάθαρτος); impurity (the quality), physically or morally: - uncleanness
; from g0169 (ἀκάθαρτος); impurity (the state), morally: - filthiness
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of g2508 (καθαίρω) (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially, (demonic)): - foul, unclean
; from a compound of g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2540 (καιρός) (meaning unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a proper occasion: - lack opportunity
; adverb from the same as g0170 (ἀκαιρέομαι); inopportunely: - out of season
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2556 (κακός); not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting: - harmless, simple
; probably from the same as g0188 (ἀκμήν); a thorn: - thorn
; from g0173 (ἄκανθα); thorny: - of thorns
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2590 (καρπός); barren (literally or figuratively): - without fruit, unfruitful
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g2607 (καταγινώσκω); unblamable: - that cannot be condemned
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of g2596 (κατά) and g2572 (καλύπτω); unveiled: - uncovered
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g2632 (κατακρίνω); without (legal) trial: - uncondemned
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g2647 (καταλύω); indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent: - endless
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g2664 (καταπαύω); unrefraining: - that cannot cease
; from g0182 (ἀκατάστατος); instability, i.e. disorder: - commotion, confusion, tumult
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g2525 (καθίστημι); inconstant: - unstable
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g2722 (κατέχω); unrestrainable: - unruly
; of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to h2506 and h1818); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem: - Aceldama
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of g2767 (κεράννυμι); unmixed, i.e. (figuratively) innocent: - harmless, simple
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2827 (κλίνω); not leaning, i.e. (figuratively) firm: - without wavering
; from the same as g0188 (ἀκμήν); to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature: - be fully ripe
; accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to (a point) and meaning the same; adverbially, just now, i.e. still: - yet
; from g0191 (ἀκούω); hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard): - audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor
; from g0001 (Α) (as a particle of union) and (a road); properly, to be in the same way with, i.e. to accompany (specially, as a disciple): - follow, reach
; a primary verb; to hear (in various senses): - give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand
; from g0193 (ἀκρατής); want of self-restraint: - excess, incontinency
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2904 (κράτος); powerless, i.e. without self-control: - incontinent
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of g2767 (κεράννυμι); undiluted: - without mixture
; from the same as g0196 (ἀκριβέστατος); exactness: - perfect manner
; superlative of (a derivative of the same as g0206 (ἄκρον)); most exact: - most straitest
; neuter of the comparative of the same as g0196 (ἀκριβέστατος); (adverbially) more exactly: - more perfect(-ly)
; from the same as g0196 (ἀκριβέστατος); to be exact, i.e. ascertain: - enquire diligently
; adverb from the same as g0196 (ἀκριβέστατος); exactly: - circumspectly, diligently, perfect(-ly)
; apparently from the same as g0206 (ἄκρον); a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation): - locust
; from g0202 (ἀκροατής); an audience-room: - place of hearing
; from (to listen; apparently an intensive of g0191 (ἀκούω)); a hearer (merely): - hearer

; from g0206 (ἄκρον) and probably a modified form of (the penis or male sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e. gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person: - not circumcised, uncircumcised (with g2192 (ἔχω)), uncircumcision
; from g0206 (ἄκρον) and g1137 (γωνία); belonging to the extreme corner: - chief corner
; from g0206 (ἄκρον) and (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty: - spoils
; neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of g0188 (ἀκμήν); the extremity: - one end… other, tip, top, uttermost participle
; probably for Latin aquila (an eagle); Akulas, an Israelite: - Aquila
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g2964 (κυρόω); to invalidate: - disannul, make of none effect
; adverb from a compound of g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of g2967 (κωλύω); in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely: - no man forbidding him
; from g0001 (Α) (as a negative particle) and g1635 (ἑκών); unwilling: - against the will
; neuter of (of uncertain derivation), the name of a stone; properly, an "alabaster" box, i.e. (by extension) a perfume vase (of any material): - (alabaster) box
; from g0213 (ἀλαζών); braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) self-confidence: - boasting, pride
; from (vagrancy); braggart: - boaster

It was heated red hot by a fire from within, and the little ones placed in its arms to be slowly burned, while to prevent the parents from hearing the dying cries, the sacrificing priests beat drums.

; from g3722 (ὄρθρος); to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes: - come early in the morning

; from g3722 (ὄρθρος); in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break: - early
; from the same as g3735 (ὄρος); dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn: - early in the morning
; adverb from g3717 (ὀρθός); in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally): - plain, right(-ly)
; from g3725 (ὅριον); to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify: - declare, determine, limit, ordain
; neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary (a bound or limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region): - border, coast
; from g3727 (ὅρκος); to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin: - adjure, charge
; from (a fence; perhaps akin to g3725 (ὅριον)); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath): - oath
; from a compound of g3727 (ὅρκος) and a derivative of g3660 (ὀμνύω); asseveration on oath: - oath
; from g3730 (ὁρμή); to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge: - run (violently), rush
; of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset: - assault
; from g3730 (ὁρμή); an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy: - violence
; neuter of a presumed derivative of g3733 (ὄρνις); a birdling: - bird, fowl
; probably from a prolonged form of the base of g3735 (ὄρος); a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl): - hen
; from a compound of the base of g3725 (ὅριον) and a derivative of g5087 (τίθημι); a limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line: - bound
; probably from an obsolete (to rise or "rear"; perhaps akin to g0142 (αἴρω); compare g3733 (ὄρνις)); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain): - hill, mount(-ain)
; apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig: - dig
; of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. parentless: - comfortless, fatherless
; middle voice from (a row or ring); to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion): - dance

; probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article g3588 (ὁ)); the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that: - one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc
; multiple adverb from g3739 (ὅς); how (i.e. with g0302 (ἄν), so) many times as: - as oft(-en) as

; of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from 1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from g2413 (ἱερός), which denotes formal consecration; and from g0040 (ἅγιος), which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure): - holy, mercy, shalt be
; from g3741 (ὅσιος); piety: - holiness
; adverb from g3741 (ὅσιος); piously: - holily
; from g3605 (ὄζω); fragrance (literally or figuratively): - odour, savour

; by reduplication from g3739 (ὅς); as (much, great, long, etc.) as: - all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who(-soever)
; from g3739 (ὅς) and g4007 (περ); who especially: - whomsoever
; of uncertain affinity; a bone: - bone
; from g3739 (ὅς) and g5100 (τὶς); which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same: - X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever)
; from ("oyster") (a tile, i.e. terra cotta); earthen-ware, i.e. clayey; by implication, frail: - of earth, earthen
; from a derivative of g3605 (ὄζω); smell (the sense): - smelling
; of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power: - loin
; from g3753 (ὅτε) and g0302 (ἄν); whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as: - as long (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while
; from g3739 (ὅς) and g5037 (τέ); at which (thing) too, i.e. when: - after (that), as soon as, that, when, while

; neuter of g3748 (ὅστις) as conjunction; demonstrative, that (sometimes redundant); causative, because: - as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why
; for the genitive case of g3748 (ὅστις) (as adverb); during which same time, i.e. whilst: - whiles

; a primary word; the absolute negative (compare g3361 (μή)) adverb; no or not: - + long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, + nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but
; genitive case of g3739 (ὅς) as adverb; at which place, i.e. where: - where(-in), whither(-soever)
; a primary exclamation of surprise; "ah": - ah
; a primary exclamation of grief; "woe": - alas, woe
; adverb from (the feminine) of g3762 (οὐδείς); by no means: - not
; from g3756 (οὐ) and g1161 (δέ); not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even: - neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as

; from g3761 (οὐδέ) and g1520 (εἷς); not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none, nobody, nothing: - any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought
; from g3761 (οὐδέ) and g4218 (ποτέ); not even at any time, i.e. never at all: - neither at any time, never, nothing at any time
; from g3761 (οὐδέ) and g4452 (-πω); not even yet: - as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet
; from g3756 (οὐ) and g2089 (ἔτι); not yet, no longer: - after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not)
; from g3756 (οὐ) and g3767 (οὖν); is it not therefore that, i.e. (affirmatively) hence or so: - then
; apparently a primary word; (adverbially) certainly, or (conjunctionally) accordingly: - and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore
; from g3756 (οὐ) and g4452 (-πω); not yet: - hitherto not, (no…) as yet, not yet
; apparently a primary word; a tail: - tail
; from g3772 (οὐρανός); celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the sky: - heavenly
; from g3772 (οὐρανός) and the enclitic of source; from the sky: - from heaven

; perhaps from the same as g3735 (ὄρος) (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity): - air, heaven(-ly), sky
; of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian: - Urbanus
; of Hebrew origin ( h0223); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite: - Urias
; apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally): - ear
; from the feminine of g5607 (ὤν); substance, i.e. property (possessions): - goods, substance
; from g3756 (οὐ) and g5037 (τέ); not too, i.e. neither or nor; by analogy, not even: - neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing

; from the article g3588 (ὁ) and g0846 (αὐτός); the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated): - he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who

; adverb from g3778 (οὗτος); in this way (referring to what precedes or follows): - after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what
; intensive of g3756 (οὐ); not indeed: - nay, not
; from g3784 (ὀφείλω); an ower, i.e. person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against God): - debtor, which owed, sinner
; from g3784 (ὀφείλω); indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty: - debt, due
; from (the alternate of) g3784 (ὀφείλω); something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault: - debt

; probably from the base of g3786 (ὄφελος) (through the idea of accruing); to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty: - behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should
; first person singular of a past tense of g3784 (ὀφείλω); I ought (wish), i.e. (interjection) oh that!: - would (to God)
; from (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); gain: - advantageth, profit
; from g3788 (ὀφθαλμός) and g1397 (δουλεία); sight-labor, i.e. that needs watching (remissness): - eye-service
; from g3700 (ὀπτάνομαι); the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance): - eye, sight
; probably from g3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (through the idea of sharpness of vision); a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially Satan: - serpent
; perhaps from g3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision); the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the brink of a precipice: - brow
; from g3793 (ὄχλος); to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass: - vex
; from g3793 (ὄχλος) and g4160 (ποιέω); to make a crowd, i.e. raise a public disturbance: - gather a company

; from a derivative of g2192 (ἔχω) (meaning a vehicle); a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot: - company, multitude, number (of people), people, press
; from a remote derivative of g2192 (ἔχω) (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely); a castle (figuratively, argument): - stronghold
; neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of g3702 (ὀπτός); a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment): - fish
; from the same as g3694 (ὀπίσω) (through the idea of backwardness); (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day: - (at) even, in the end
; from g3796 (ὀψέ); later, i.e. vernal (showering): - latter
; from g3796 (ὀψέ); late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve): - even(-ing, (-tide))
; from g3700 (ὀπτάνομαι); properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show: - appearance, countenance, face
; neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as g3795 (ὀψάριον); rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay: - wages

keynum.langWord: ὁ ὢν καί ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
keynum.phon: kai ho ēn kai ho erchomenos
keynum.meaning: ; a phrase combining g3588 (ὁ) with the present participle and imperfect of g1510 (εἰμί) and the present participle of g2064 (ἔρχομαι) by means of g2532 (καί); the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e. the Eternal, as a divine epithet of Christ: - which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be)
; from g3803 (παγίς); to ensnare (figuratively): - entangle
; from g4078 (πήγνυμι); a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation): - snare
; from a presumed derivative of g3806 (πάθος); something undergone, i.e. hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence: - affection, affliction, motion, suffering
; from the same as g3804 (πάθημα); liable (i.e. doomed) to experience pain: - suffer
; from the alternate of g3958 (πάσχω); properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence): - (inordinate) affection, lust

; from g3816 (παῖς) and a reduplicated form of g0071 (ἄγω); a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue")): - instructor, schoolmaster
; neuter of a presumed derivative of g3816 (παῖς); a little boy: - child, lad
; from g3811 (παιδεύω); tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction: - chastening, chastisement, instruction, nurture
; from g3811 (παιδεύω); a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication) discipliner: - which corrected, instructor
; from g3816 (παῖς); to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment): - chasten(-ise), instruct, learn, teach
; adverb (of source) from g3813 (παιδίον); from infancy: - of a child

; neuter diminutive of g3816 (παῖς); a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian: - (little, young) child, damsel
; feminine diminutive of g3816 (παῖς); a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant: - bondmaid(-woman), damsel, maid(-en)
; from g3816 (παῖς); to sport (as a boy): - play

; perhaps from g3817 (παίω); a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God): - child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man
; a primary verb; to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than g5180 (τύπτω)); specially, to sting (as a scorpion): - smite, strike
; feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation; Pacatianian, a section of Phrygia: - Pacatiana

; probably another form for g3825 (πάλιν) (through the idea of retrocession); (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient: - any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past
; from g3819 (πάλαι); antique, i.e. not recent, worn out: - old
; from g3820 (παλαιός); antiquatedness: - oldness
; from g3820 (παλαιός); to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete: - decay, make (wax) old
; from (to vibrate; another form for g0906 (βάλλω)); wrestling: - + wrestle
; from g3825 (πάλιν) and g1078 (γένεσις); (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration: - regeneration

; probably from the same as g3823 (πάλη) (through the idea of oscillatory repetition); (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand: - again
; dative case (adverb) of a compound of g3956 (πᾶς) and g4128 (πλῆθος); in full multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously: - all at once
; from g3956 (πᾶς) and g4183 (πολύς); full many, i.e. immense: - very great
; from a compound of g3956 (πᾶς) and g4443 (πυρά); every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous ( g5561 (χώρα) being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor: - Pamphylia
; neuter of a presumed compound of g3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of g1209 (δέχομαι); all-receptive, i.e. a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan): - inn
; from the same as g3829 (πανδοχεῖον); an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai): - host
; from g3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of g0058 (ἀγορά); a mass-meeting, i.e. (figuratively) universal companionship: - general assembly
; adverb from g3956 (πᾶς) and g3624 (οἶκος); with the whole family: - with all his house
; from a compound of g3956 (πᾶς) and g3696 (ὅπλον); full armor ("panoply"): - all (whole) armour
; from g3835 (πανοῦργος); adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry: - (cunning) craftiness, subtilty
; from g3956 (πᾶς) and g2041 (ἔργον); all-working, i.e. adroit (shrewd): - crafty
; adverb (of source) from g3837 (πανταχοῦ); from all directions: - from every quarter
; genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of g3956 (πᾶς); universally: - in all places, everywhere
; from g3956 (πᾶς) and g5056 (τέλος); full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion): - + in (no) wise, uttermost
; adverb (of manner) from g3956 (πᾶς); wholly: - always
; adverb (of source) from g3956 (πᾶς); from (i.e. on) all sides: - on every side, round about
; from g3956 (πᾶς) and g2904 (κράτος); the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign): - Almighty, Omnipotent
; from g3956 (πᾶς) and g3753 (ὅτε); every when, i.e. at all times: - alway(-s), ever(-more)
; adverb from g3956 (πᾶς); entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event: - by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely

; a primary preposition; properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of): - above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side…by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with
; from g3844 (παρά) and the base of g0939 (βάσις); to go contrary to, i.e. violate a command: - (by) transgress(-ion)
; from g3844 (παρά) and g0906 (βάλλω); to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken: - arrive, compare
; from g3845 (παραβαίνω); violation: - breaking, transgression
; from g3845 (παραβαίνω); a violator: - breaker, transgress(-or)
; from g3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of g0971 (βιάζω); to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty): - constrain
; from g3846 (παραβάλλω); a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage: - comparison, figure, parable, proverb
; from g3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of g1011 (βουλεύω); to misconsult, i.e. disregard: - not (to) regard(-ing)
; from g3853 (παραγγέλλω); a mandate: - charge, command
; from g3844 (παρά) and the base of g0032 (ἄγγελος); to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin: - (give in) charge, (give) command(-ment), declare
; from g3844 (παρά) and g1096 (γίνομαι); to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly: - come, go, be present
; from g3844 (παρά) and g0071 (ἄγω); to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away: - depart, pass (away, by, forth)
; from g3844 (παρά) and g1165 (δειγματίζω); to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy: - make a public example, put to an open shame
; of Oriental origin (compare h6508); a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise"): - paradise
; from g3844 (παρά) and g1209 (δέχομαι); to accept near, i.e. admit or (by implication) delight in: - receive
; from a compound of g3844 (παρά) and g1304 (διατρίβω); misemployment, i.e. meddlesomeness: - perverse disputing
; from g3844 (παρά) and g1325 (δίδωμι); to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit: - betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend
; from g3844 (παρά) and g1391 (δόξα) (in the sense of seeming); contrary to expectation, i.e. extraordinary ("paradox"): - strange
; from g3860 (παραδίδωμι); transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the Jewish traditionary law: - ordinance, tradition
; from g3844 (παρά) and g2206 (ζηλόω); to stimulate alongside, i.e. excite to rivalry: - provoke to emulation (jealousy)
; from g3844 (παρά) and g2281 (θάλασσα); along the sea, i.e. maritime (lacustrine): - upon the sea coast
; from g3844 (παρά) and g2334 (θεωρέω); to overlook or disregard: - neglect
; from g3908 (παρατίθημι); a deposit, i.e. (figuratively) trust: - committed unto
; from g3844 (παρά) and g0134 (αἰνέω); to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course): - admonish, exhort
; from g3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of g0154 (αἰτέω); to beg off, i.e. deprecate, decline, shun: - avoid, (make) excuse, intreat, refuse, reject
; from g3844 (παρά) and g2523 (καθίζω); to sit down near: - sit

; from g3844 (παρά) and g2564 (καλέω); to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation): - beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray
; from g3844 (παρά) and g2572 (καλύπτω); to cover alongside, i.e. veil (figuratively): - hide
; from a compound of g3844 (παρά) and g2698 (κατατίθημι); something put down alongside, i.e. a deposit (sacred trust): - that (thing) which is committed (un-)to (trust)
; from g3844 (παρά) and g2749 (κεῖμαι); to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy): - be present
; from g3870 (παρακαλέω); imploration, hortation, solace: - comfort, consolation, exhortation, intreaty
; an intercessor, consoler: - advocate, comforter
; from g3878 (παρακούω); inattention, i.e. (by implication) disobedience: - disobedience
; from g3844 (παρά) and g0190 (ἀκολουθέω); to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to: - attain, follow, fully know, have understanding
; from g3844 (παρά) and g0191 (ἀκούω); to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey: - neglect to hear
; from g3844 (παρά) and g2955 (κύπτω); to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within): - look (into), stoop down

; from g3844 (παρά) and g2983 (λαμβάνω); to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn: - receive, take (unto, with)
; from g3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of g3004 (λέγω) (in its original sense); (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. sail past: - pass, sail by
; from g3844 (παρά) and g0251 (ἅλς); beside the salt (sea), i.e. maritime: - sea coast
; from a compound of g3844 (παρά) and g0236 (ἀλλάσσω); transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness: - variableness
; from g3844 (παρά) and g3049 (λογίζομαι); to misreckon, i.e. delude: - beguile, deceive
; from a derivative of g3886 (παραλύω); as if dissolved, i.e. "paralytic": - that had (sick of) the palsy

keynum.phon: that had (sick of) the palsy. 359 g3886 paralu>w, — par-al-oo’-o
keynum.meaning: ; from g3844 (παρά) and g3089 (λύω); to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled): - feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy
; from g3844 (παρά) and g3306 (μένω); to stay near, i.e. remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere): - abide, continue
; from g3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of a derivative of g3454 (μῦθος); to relate near, i.e. (by implication) encourage, console: - comfort
; from g3888 (παραμυθέομαι); consolation (properly, abstract): - comfort
; neuter of g3889 (παραμυθία); consolation (properly, concretely): - comfort
; from a compound of g3844 (παρά) and g3551 (νόμος); to be opposed to law, i.e. to transgress: - contrary to law
; from the same as g3891 (παρανομέω); transgression: - iniquity
; from g3844 (παρά) and g4087 (πικραίνω); to embitter alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate: - provoke
; from g3893 (παραπικραίνω); irritation: - provocation
; from g3844 (παρά) and g4098 (πίπτω); to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize: - fall away
; from g3844 (παρά) and g4126 (πλέω); to sail near: - sail by
; neuter of a compound of g3844 (παρά) and the base of g4139 (πλησίον) (as adverb); close by, i.e. (figuratively) almost: - nigh unto

; probably from g5343 (φεύγω); fugitive; Phygellus, an apostate Christian: - Phygellus
; from g5343 (φεύγω); a fleeing, i.e. escape: - flight

; from g5442 (φυλάσσω); a guarding or (concretely, guard), the act, the person; figuratively, the place, the condition, or (specially), the time (as a division of day or night), literally or figuratively: - cage, hold, (im-)prison(-ment), ward, watch

; from g5457 (φῶς) and g5342 (φέρω); light-bearing ("phosphorus"), i.e. (specially), the morning-star (figuratively): - day star

; a primary verb; to be "cheer"ful, i.e. calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well: - farewell, be glad, God speed, greeting, hall, joy(- fully), rejoice

; probably strengthened from (to rub or touch the surface; compare g5597 (ψώχω)); to twitch or twang, i.e. to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes): - make melody, sing (psalms)

; from g5571 (ψευδής) and g4396 (προφήτης); a spurious prophet, i.e. pretended foreteller or religious impostor: - false prophet
